key_path: Sign up for Jira Cloud Free (atlassian.com/software/jira/free) with Google/Microsoft/Apple OAuth or email
Verify email (if email signup) and choose site name (<site>.atlassian.net)
Re-verify identity (required for password/third-party logins before token creation; re-prompted after 30 min idle)
Create API token (classic or 'with scopes'), set expiry 1-365 days, copy
human_gates_notes: Identity re-verification step before token creation (email code). Rovo MCP API-token auth must be enabled by org admin; org admins can block MCP/ restrict domains. SSO/service-account users skip verification.

agent_native_auth.cli_device_login: partial - Atlassian CLI (acli) has 'acli jira auth login --web'; not verified in this pass
agent_native_auth.mcp_oauth_dcr: yes - v2 auth server advertises /dcr/register and client_id_metadata_document_supported=true (verified)
agent_native_auth.personal_access_tokens: yes - API tokens (Basic auth), max 1 year expiry
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes - 'Create API token with scopes' (granular Jira/Confluence scopes)
agent_native_auth.management_api_mints_keys: partial - service accounts with API keys via admin; no self-serve key-minting API for users
agent_native_auth.free_tier_or_sandbox: yes - Jira/Confluence Free (10 users); developer sandbox via go.atlassian.com/cloud-dev

remote.url: https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp (v1 still responds 401; Claude directory entry still points at /v1/mcp)
remote.auth: OAuth 2.1 with DCR; or API token (Basic email:token) / service-account API key (Bearer) if org admin enables API-token auth

mcp.type: product MCP (Rovo MCP: Jira, Confluence, Compass, Teamwork Graph)
mcp.one_click_install: marketplace extensions / documented setup for VS Code+Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Windsurf

score_justification: Solid scoped tokens and a DCR MCP, but identity re-verification before token creation, admin toggle for MCP token auth, credit-metered Rovo tools, and no llms.txt.
best_practice: Scoped API tokens with mandatory expiry (1-365 days) plus a service-account API key path for headless MCP.
biggest_gap: No llms.txt/markdown docs and MCP API-token auth is off until an org admin flips it; v1->v2 URL churn leaves directory listings stale.
